body.description: Use case: stylized-concept. STYLE TAKES PRIORITY: STRICT outline-only 16-bit arcade pixel graphics on uniform pure black. Fighters are hollow silhouettes traced by ONE coarse-pixel-thick cyan allied contour or vermilion enemy contour. Their interiors MUST remain entirely black; no filled normal RPG sprites, anatomy, faces, armor, textures or realistic light. Equipment is a single bold outlined shield, bow, paired blades, club or spear. Floor is black with tiny dim blue-gray cell-corner ticks, NO continuous bright grid. Blocks are dim simple hollow outlines; hazard spikes white jagged outline, acid lime irregular outline. Selected-cell corners and three path dots are solid cyan. HP is one simple partly-empty3segment bar. No glow/bloom, no gradient, no particles. Make the sparse outline language unmistakably different from filled sprites. Create ONE complete readable tactical fantasy battlefield image, not a sprite sheet or collage. Common comparison scene: an isolated square 8-by-8 board (64 visible cells), shallow isometric view with broad 4:3 diamond tile tops, all edges visible, no perspective vanishing. Three small allied mercenaries occupy the near-left third: shield fighter, longbow archer, dual-dagger rogue. Three hostile fighters occupy the far-right third: broad club wielder, narrow spear wielder, jagged bow wielder. Each figure stands inside ONE cell; weapons and gaps separate silhouettes. Two solid stone blocks interrupt the middle; leave a clear route around them. A single raised floor-spike tile and a separate acid-puddle tile must differ by SHAPE, not only color. One ally has a double-corner selected-cell marker; three empty cells have tiny path dots; one short three-segment health bar is partly empty. Team identity uses round allied bases versus notched hostile bases as well as color. Keep floor calm, characters and hazards highest contrast. No extra actors, mage, scenery, text, numbers, logo, HUD panel, blur, bloom or random pixel noise. 4:3 landscape. Use crisp coarse square pixels throughout.
